name: Mana
description: You have 2 level-1 spell slots. Expend one to cast a prepared level-1 spell. You regain all expended mana after a Long Rest.

name: Innate Sorcery
description: As a Bonus Action, you unleash your simmering magic for 1 minute: the spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1, and you have Advantage on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast. You regain all expended uses after a Long Rest.
